# NVIDIA Pre-Meeting Briefing: Meeting of 17 November 2026

**Prepared:** 15 November 2026 | **Review window:** 16 October to 15 November 2026 | **Meeting context:** NVIDIA Q3 FY2027 results are scheduled for 17 November 2026, the same day as the meeting.

## Executive Summary

NVIDIA's board announced on 12 November 2026 that co-founder Jensen Huang had resigned as President, Chief Executive Officer, and board member, effective immediately. CFO Colette Kress was appointed Interim CEO while keeping her CFO role, and Harvey C. Jones became the company's first-ever board chair ([NVIDIA Corporation, 2026](https://investor.nvidia.com/news/press-release-details/2026/NVIDIA-Announces-CEO-Transition)). This is the most significant development in the window. Reports link the resignation to personal relationships, but the company has not confirmed a reason ([True Tech, 2026](https://true-tech.net/jensen-huang-resigns-nvidia-ceo)).

Three points frame the meeting:

1. **Leadership concentration.** The executive who signed off on many of NVIDIA's strategic investments and "circular financing" deals now runs the company and presents its results ([Associated Press, 2026](https://apnews.com/article/nvidia-jensen-huang-colette-kress-39ea208c040539166e10d8c6f473bc57)).
2. **Balance-sheet exposure.** Reported commitments and guarantees total about $530 billion, while receivables have grown ([Yahoo Finance, 2026](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/article/jensen-huangs-exit-puts-nvidias-530-billion-web-of-ai-deals-under-the-microscope-153142269.html)).
3. **Imminent earnings test.** Results on 17 November will be the first major disclosure under interim leadership.

Operational continuity has been stated by the board, and the product and partnership cadence in the window remained active.

## 1. Leadership Change

### 1.1 CEO Transition

The company's press release states that Huang resigned "effective immediately" and that Kress will serve as Interim CEO until a permanent successor is named ([NVIDIA Corporation, 2026](https://investor.nvidia.com/news/press-release-details/2026/NVIDIA-Announces-CEO-Transition)). Reporting indicates the board will consider both internal and external candidates ([CNBC, 2026](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/11/12/nvidia-jensen-huang-ceo-live-updates.html)). Board chair Jones stated the board has "full confidence" in Kress and that operations, customer commitments, and the product roadmap are expected to continue "without interruption" ([CNBC, 2026](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/11/12/nvidia-jensen-huang-ceo-live-updates.html)).

Kress joined NVIDIA in September 2013 after nearly 25 years in finance roles at Cisco and Microsoft ([True Tech, 2026](https://true-tech.net/jensen-huang-resigns-nvidia-ceo)). Huang had served as CEO for more than 33 years ([TahawulTech, 2026](https://www.tahawultech.com/home-slide/jensen-huang-resigns-as-nvidia-ceo-colette-kress-named-interim-chief)).

### 1.2 Board Structure

Jones, who previously served as CEO and executive chair of Synopsys, is NVIDIA's first-ever board chair ([Yahoo Finance, 2026](https://finance.yahoo.com/technology/article/nvidia-ceo-huang-resigns-amid-affair-scandals-board-names-cfo-colette-kress-interim-ceo-135801377.html?fr=sycsrp_catchall)). One source states he has served on the board since its founding in 1993 ([True Tech, 2026](https://true-tech.net/jensen-huang-resigns-nvidia-ceo)). This is a single-source claim and should be verified against the proxy statement.

Two other board-related communications appeared in the window: a "Statement From NVIDIA Board of Directors" and a "Statement From the Independent Members of the NVIDIA Board," dated 8 and 10 November respectively ([NVIDIA Newsroom, 2026](http://nvidianews.nvidia.com/news/nvidia-announces-strategic-partnership-with-lumentum-to-develop-state-of-the-art-optics-technology)). The content of these statements was not available in the provided material and could not be verified.

### 1.3 Reported Context (Flagged)

Reporting cites reports of an extramarital affair involving a senior NVIDIA executive and a separate relationship with a woman whom US officials reportedly suspect of Chinese intelligence links ([True Tech, 2026](https://true-tech.net/jensen-huang-resigns-nvidia-ceo); [Associated Press, 2026](https://apnews.com/article/nvidia-jensen-huang-colette-kress-39ea208c040539166e10d8c6f473bc57)). Yahoo Finance reports that Huang admitted to the second relationship ([Yahoo Finance, 2026](https://finance.yahoo.com/technology/article/nvidia-ceo-huang-resigns-amid-affair-scandals-board-names-cfo-colette-kress-interim-ceo-135801377.html?fr=sycsrp_catchall)). **These allegations are unverified by NVIDIA.** The company's announcement did not disclose a reason for the departure ([True Tech, 2026](https://true-tech.net/jensen-huang-resigns-nvidia-ceo)).

Policy exposure is also significant. Huang had been a prominent voice on US AI policy and a close ally of the President ([CNBC, 2026](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/11/12/nvidia-jensen-huang-ceo-live-updates.html)). CNBC reports that Democrats are poised to take control of both houses of Congress and have promised investigations related to NVIDIA. Huang has reportedly agreed to testify before Congress before Thanksgiving ([CNBC, 2026](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/11/12/nvidia-jensen-huang-ceo-live-updates.html)). The date of testimony has not been confirmed.

### 1.4 Market Reaction

Reports state NVIDIA shares fell nearly 12% in early trading on 12 November 2026 ([True Tech, 2026](https://true-tech.net/jensen-huang-resigns-nvidia-ceo); [Yahoo Finance, 2026](https://finance.yahoo.com/technology/article/nvidia-ceo-huang-resigns-amid-affair-scandals-board-names-cfo-colette-kress-interim-ceo-135801377.html?fr=sycsrp_catchall)). However, a Yahoo Finance quote snapshot showed NVDA at -3.12%, with no timestamp. **The two figures are inconsistent and the snapshot time is unknown, so the closing move should be verified before use.** Quantisnow's AI-generated summary describes the transition as "negative for shareholders," but this is an opinion from an automated tool, not a verified market finding ([Quantisnow, n.d.](https://quantisnow.com/insight/nvidia-announces-ceo-transition-6786728)). Quantisnow's historical analysis of prior leadership changes is paywalled and was not reviewed.

A competitive development also appeared in the window. This is relevant because OpenAI is a major NVIDIA counterparty.

**Acquisitions.** Tracxn lists Hugging Face as NVIDIA's most recent acquisition, completed in September 2026, with its own data showing a price of "*****" (undisclosed) ([Tracxn, 2026](https://tracxn.com/d/acquisitions/acquisitions-by-nvidia/__Rwvr9cCWEygAYAiBEK0RuL1AbkKNw9sBGPqMEY6zVh4)). This falls just outside the 30-day window. No new acquisitions were identified within the window.

## 3. Product Launches and Announcements

Within the window, NVIDIA's own product and platform news was modest in the sources reviewed. The company's newsroom reported the Rebellions and SK Telecom collaboration on 8 November and the open-source expansion on 10 November ([NVIDIA Newsroom, 2026](http://nvidianews.nvidia.com/news/nvidia-announces-strategic-partnership-with-lumentum-to-develop-state-of-the-art-optics-technology); [NVIDIA Blog, 2026](https://blogs.nvidia.com/blog/nvidia-to-acquire-hugging-face)). Earlier 2026 platform launches, including Vera Rubin and Spectrum-X, fall outside the window ([Network World, 2026](https://www.networkworld.com/article/3562856/nvidia-latest-news-and-insights.html)).

The Hugging Face-linked "Microduck" robot launch was reported on 24 October by TechCrunch+ ([Tracxn, 2026](https://tracxn.com/d/acquisitions/acquisitions-by-nvidia/__Rwvr9cCWEygAYAiBEK0RuL1AbkKNw9sBGPqMEY6zVh4)).

## 4. Hires and Executive Moves

| Role | Person | Change | Source |
|---|---|---|---|
| CEO | Jensen Huang | Resigned, effective immediately | [NVIDIA Corporation, 2026](https://investor.nvidia.com/news/press-release-details/2026/NVIDIA-Announces-CEO-Transition) |
| Interim CEO (also CFO) | Colette Kress | Appointed; retains CFO role | [NVIDIA Corporation, 2026](https://investor.nvidia.com/news/press-release-details/2026/NVIDIA-Announces-CEO-Transition) |
| Board Chair (first-ever) | Harvey C. Jones | Appointed | [NVIDIA Corporation, 2026](https://investor.nvidia.com/news/press-release-details/2026/NVIDIA-Announces-CEO-Transition) |

No other executive hires or departures were identified in the sources reviewed. Kress convened the executive team at headquarters on 12 November ([CNBC, 2026](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/11/12/nvidia-jensen-huang-ceo-live-updates.html)). Reports state the company will look both internally and externally for a permanent CEO ([Yahoo Finance, 2026](https://finance.yahoo.com/technology/article/nvidia-ceo-huang-resigns-amid-affair-scandals-board-names-cfo-colette-kress-interim-ceo-135801377.html?fr=sycsrp_catchall)). The sources did not report a timeline for that search.

## 5. Financial Position and Exposure

Key figures from the window, as reported by secondary sources:

| Metric | Figure | Source |
|---|---|---|
| Cash and securities (end of July 2026) | ~$99 billion | [Yahoo Finance, 2026](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/article/jensen-huangs-exit-puts-nvidias-530-billion-web-of-ai-deals-under-the-microscope-153142269.html) |
| Debt (end of July 2026) | ~$33 billion | [Yahoo Finance, 2026](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/article/jensen-huangs-exit-puts-nvidias-530-billion-web-of-ai-deals-under-the-microscope-153142269.html) |
| Commitments and guarantees (latest filing, per Yahoo count) | ~$530 billion | [Yahoo Finance, 2026](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/article/jensen-huangs-exit-puts-nvidias-530-billion-web-of-ai-deals-under-the-microscope-153142269.html) |
| Cloud capacity rent-back (e.g., CoreWeave) | ~$65 billion | [Yahoo Finance, 2026](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/article/jensen-huangs-exit-puts-nvidias-530-billion-web-of-ai-deals-under-the-microscope-153142269.html) |
| OpenAI Ohio data center lease guarantee | Up to $105 billion | [Yahoo Finance, 2026](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/article/jensen-huangs-exit-puts-nvidias-530-billion-web-of-ai-deals-under-the-microscope-153142269.html) |
| Accounts receivable (last quarter) | ~$63 billion | [Yahoo Finance, 2026](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/article/jensen-huangs-exit-puts-nvidias-530-billion-web-of-ai-deals-under-the-microscope-153142269.html) |
| Collection period | ~60 days, up from 45 | [Yahoo Finance, 2026](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/article/jensen-huangs-exit-puts-nvidias-530-billion-web-of-ai-deals-under-the-microscope-153142269.html) |

NVIDIA's equity portfolio includes stakes in Intel, SpaceX, CoreWeave, Coherent, and Safe Superintelligence. It also holds a $30 billion stake in OpenAI, with a preliminary deal to invest up to $100 billion more. The value of its largest public holdings has fallen by more than $20 billion since June, led by Intel ([Yahoo Finance, 2026](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/article/jensen-huangs-exit-puts-nvidias-530-billion-web-of-ai-deals-under-the-microscope-153142269.html)). The 2 March 2026 investment of $2 billion in Lumentum is also part of this pattern of strategic equity stakes ([NVIDIA Newsroom, 2026](http://nvidianews.nvidia.com/news/nvidia-announces-strategic-partnership-with-lumentum-to-develop-state-of-the-art-optics-technology)).

Earlier background from Network World reports an August 2026 plan by NVIDIA and six financial partners to create a $500 billion investment pool to help customers buy chips on credit ([Network World, 2026](https://www.networkworld.com/article/3562856/nvidia-latest-news-and-insights.html)). This predates the window but bears on the receivables trend.

Yahoo Finance quotes analysts describing these arrangements as "circular relationships," in which NVIDIA invests in companies that then buy its chips ([Yahoo Finance, 2026](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/article/jensen-huangs-exit-puts-nvidias-530-billion-web-of-ai-deals-under-the-microscope-153142269.html)). Yahoo also notes that the OpenAI guarantee pays out only in an OpenAI default, a scenario that would likely coincide with weaker NVIDIA sales ([Yahoo Finance, 2026](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/article/jensen-huangs-exit-puts-nvidias-530-billion-web-of-ai-deals-under-the-microscope-153142269.html)).

## 6. Upcoming Q3 FY2027 Results

NVIDIA will report Q3 FY2027 results on Tuesday, 17 November 2026, at approximately 1:20 p.m. PT. The earnings call starts at 2:00 p.m. PT ([NVIDIA Newsroom, 2026](https://nvidianews.nvidia.
